* '''Playtest''' ([[Ahch-To (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-ahchto-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/ahchto.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), mark “E”. Text: Light Side: “During your deploy phase, you may deploy one Dagobah site directly from Reserve Deck. Shuffle, cut and replace.” Dark Side: “Neither player may Force drain here.” The title strips print “•DAGOBAH”. This Playtest image is a picture of the underlying Decipher card [[Dagobah]] (title, game text and an “E” mark of the Dagobah card), published under this card's file name the day before release.
* '''Original''' ([[Ahch-To]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-ahchto-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d24ffc3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/ahchto.gif Holotable commit d24ffc3 “Flipped sites”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Once during any deploy phase, may use 1 Force to relocate Luke between any two Ahch-To sites.” Dark Side: “While you occupy an Ahch-To site, its game text is canceled. Players may not Force drain here.” '''What changed:''' before release: the picture of the Decipher card Dagobah was replaced by this card (title “•AHCH-TO”, new artwork, new game text, lower-left margin “Dagobah (Light)”).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 29 March 2023): Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-L-ahchto.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/hires/ahchto.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Once during any deploy phase, may use 1 Force to relocate Luke between any two Ahch-To sites.” Dark Side: “While you occupy an Ahch-To site, its game text is canceled. Players may not Force drain here.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: same words; the art credit “Image courtesy of Fragile Studios” moved to the left edge; re-rendered at high resolution (new credit line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”).
*: [[File:V11-L-ahchto-20230329-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
